summary: MUS-001 IMPLEMENTED per owner decision (2026-09-29: fix the contract, keep the copy). SubscriptionManager is now a non-custodial 75/25 splitter: immutable PLATFORM_FEE_BPS=2500 constant (no setter), per-plan creator set once at createPlan (immutable, zero address reverts MissingCreator), subscribe/renew push 75% (+rounding remainder) to the creator and 25% to the owner immediately, withdraw() removed so no balance accrues. Frontend reads the split on-chain via a new useSubscriptionManager hook (mirrors useMovieTicket) with a canonical shared-config mirror; pricing.ts and the pricing page derive the displayed 75% from it. Marketing copy kept. Contracts remain UNAUDITED — no audit claim added anywhere. No 22.28% occurrence found in docs or frontend (controller's grep confirmed; whitepaper already said 75%).
